title: Daily briefing: Mathematicians up in arms over OpenAI’s preprint deluge
title_zh: 数学家对 OpenAI 预印本潮愤怒不已
abstract: OpenAI has released 700 preprints tackling maths problems. Plus, a gut microbe could protect against cardiovascular disease and the value of silent meetings.
abstract_zh: OpenAI 已发布 700 篇针对数学问题的预印本。此外，一种肠道微生物可能有助于防治心血管疾病，以及静默会议的价值。
